owner_thread: World and asset design (items, art, text). Mechanics applies modifiers, money and save. Physics owns physics_hook fields. UI owns the shop screen.
notes: All 'mods' are deltas on Skills.modifiers, in rating points on the 1-100 scale, using canonical Skills keys only.
All gear and service mods for one player are summed per key, then each key is clamped to +/- 8 (rules.gear_mod_cap).

'protect' values are absolute percentages per Injury.PARTS body part: the chance that an injury rolled on that part drops one severity step (a day-to-day becomes nothing). Per part, protection from all worn items is summed and capped at rules.protect_cap.
'physics_hook' fields are proposals for the Physics thread and do nothing until PhysicsProfile reads them. 'interim_mods' are what Mechanics applies until then.
Prices are whole dollars. 'stage' is the shop stage at which an item first appears in stock.

currency.name: dollars
currency.start_cash_text: The jar on your dresser. Mostly loonies, one button.

rules.spare_stick_note: When a stick breaks the player finishes the game with the team's bucket stick (stock settings, flex 85) and the broken one is gone.

ideal_flex.note: Use the trained value, not eff(), so the flex modifier cannot feed back into itself.

shop.name: Bev's Edge & Tape
shop.location: Main Street, across the parking lot from Millbrook Community Arena

owner.name: Beverly "Bev" Kowalchuk
owner.machine: Old Bertha, a 1979 floor-standing sharpener whose maker went out of business in 1983

hours.closed_day_text: CLOSED SUNDAYS. Bev is at church or the casino in Kessler. She won't say which.

stages.name: Old Bertha
stages.adds: Honest Hockey, Shorewood, CMC basics, the used rack. Hollows 3/8, 1/2, 5/8. Steam curve and lie on wood sticks. Cuts and plugs. Tape.

stages.name: The New Wheel
stages.adds: Hollows 5/16 and 3/4. Heat gun curve jobs on composites. Kodiak and Warlock entry sticks, CMC mid gear, vintage goalie pads.

stages.name: The Back Room
stages.adds: 1 inch hollow, the profiling jig, lie jobs on composites, full goalie wall, Kodiak and Warlock pro sticks, the shooting lane with a radar gun.

stages.name: Authorised Dealer
stages.adds: Elite sticks, Grafton Blades fitting by appointment, the dual-radius Kessler Special profile.

stages.name: Custom Orders
stages.adds: Grafton Atelier. Custom-order sticks with any curve, lie and flex at no fee, delivered 7 calendar days later.

shop.stage_rule: stage = max(tier_stage, rink_stage), where tier_stage is the highest stage whose unlock.tier <= career tier and rink_stage the highest whose unlock.rink_age <= Millbrook's renovation age.

economy.note: Proposal for Mechanics. Beer league players pay to play; money arrives through rink shifts and small bonuses until Senior AAA pays gas money.

side_jobs.name: Rink rat shift at Millbrook Community Arena
side_jobs.desc: Flood the ice, run the skate rental window, find the lost-and-found's newest smell.

side_jobs.name: Ref a kids' game
side_jobs.desc: Forty minutes of whistles and one parent who has notes.

sponsorship.note: Open question: a brand offers free gear of its own make plus a stipend if you use only that brand.

kodiak.name: Kodiak
kodiak.voice: Heritage and earnest. Bears, lodges, sepia. Since 1924, probably.

cmc.name: CMC, the Canadian Mitten Company
cmc.voice: Polite, cosy, a little apologetic about how safe you will feel.

warlock.name: Warlock Hockey
warlock.voice: Edgy and all caps. Runes, smoke, a lot of the word DARK.

honest.name: Honest Hockey Co.
honest.voice: Truth in advertising, to a fault.

shorewood.name: Shorewood
shorewood.voice: Lake cottage, slow, woodsy, proud of trees.

grafton.name: Grafton Blades
grafton.voice: Swiss-watch luxury. Microns. Fittings by appointment.

sharpening.note: Fresh edge gives the hollow's full mods for full_games, then fades linearly to 0 over fade_games while the dull penalty fades in. A practice counts as half a game. Only at Bev's, so a road trip means leaving sharp.

profiling.note: Rocker radius. Persists until the skates are replaced or re-profiled. Skater skates only.

curve_depth.note: Blade curve depth. Stock depth is set per stick. One curve job changes depth and/or curve position for one fee.

curve_position.note: Where the curve sits on the blade. Changed in the same curve job as depth.

lie.note: Higher lie keeps the blade near your skates for tight handling. Lower lie puts it out front for poke checks and stick lifts. The reach side needs a Physics hook; interim_mods stand in through hitting until then.

flex.note: Effect depends on how stiff the stick is for this player. d = (flex - ideal_flex) / 10, clamped to -3..3, linearly interpolated between rows.

tape.note: A tape job lasts 4 games. A roll does 3 jobs. Bev tapes for $4 if you buy nothing, free with a roll. Colour is cosmetic.

custom_order.note: Any stick in stock, built to your curve, curve position, lie and flex. No heat jobs, so no extra break chance.

items.name: Uncle Ray's Shorewood
items.desc: Found in Ray's garage behind the snowblower. Ray liked them stiff and curved like a canoe. Ray also never scored.

items.name: Shorewood Lumberjack
items.desc: Solid ash. Grown for sixty years by a tree that never once complained. Soft hands, slow release, lasts until your grandkids lose it.

items.name: Shorewood Lakehouse
items.desc: Maple and ash with a fibreglass wrap, finished by a dock in late August. Smells faintly of sunscreen.

items.name: Shorewood 1952
items.desc: Hand-shaped in the old shop on Loon Point. Each one is signed by Walter, who is 91 and does not take questions.

items.name: Honest HC Standard
items.desc: It's a stick. It's a little heavy. It will be fine. We checked.

items.name: Honest HC Plus
items.desc: The Standard, but we spent more on it. You can tell, a bit.

items.name: Honest HC "Pretty Good, Actually"
items.desc: Our legal team asked us to stop calling it 'Basically A Kodiak'. So: pretty good, actually.

items.name: Kodiak Trapper
items.desc: Mid kick, honest weight, built for the slapshot your father described at every Thanksgiving. Kodiak. Since 1924.

items.name: Kodiak Grizzly Classic
items.desc: The bear on the shaft has been redrawn eleven times. The stick has not needed it once.

items.name: Kodiak Heritage Pro 1924
items.desc: Carbon laid by hand in a lodge we built for the photo shoot. The lodge is real. The heritage is very real. The year is approximately real.

items.name: Warlock HEX
items.desc: LOW KICK. HIGH CURSE. THE GOALIE NEVER SEES IT COMING. NEITHER DO YOU.

items.name: Warlock COVEN PRO
items.desc: FORGED IN DARKNESS. BALANCED IN A WIND TUNNEL. SOLD IN THREE COLOURS OF BLACK.

items.name: Warlock NECRO-X ULTRALIGHT
items.desc: 340 GRAMS OF PURE MALEVOLENCE. WARRANTY VOID IF USED NEAR A SLAPSHOT, A CROSSBAR OR A STRONG OPINION.

items.name: Shorewood Backstop (goalie)
items.desc: A paddle of solid birch. Pucks hit it and simply lose interest.

items.name: Kodiak Den (goalie)
items.desc: Light enough to move before you think about it. Kodiak goaltenders do not think. They hibernate, then react.

items.name: Kodiak Pioneer (1988, hand-me-down)
items.desc: Brown leather, laced with butcher's twine, heavy as a mailbox. Your ankles will survive anything, including a car.

items.name: Honest Strider
items.desc: Skates. Two of them. One for each foot, which we feel is the right number.

items.name: Honest Strider Plus
items.desc: Lighter than the Strider because we took some padding out. We're telling you that up front.

items.name: Kodiak Glacier
items.desc: A stiff boot for long, proud strides across frozen lakes, ideally in a commercial with a bear.

items.name: Kodiak Summit Pro
items.desc: Heat-moulded to your foot in Bev's toaster oven, which she promises is only for skates now.

items.name: Grafton Edge Precision
items.desc: Steel ground to a tolerance of four microns. Ankle padding ground to a tolerance of 'you'll be fine'.

items.name: Grafton Atelier
items.desc: Fitted by appointment by a man named Laurent, who measures each foot twice and sighs once.

items.name: Honest Goalie Skate
items.desc: Low and flat with a cowling. It goes side to side. Mostly sideways.

items.name: Kodiak Crease
items.desc: Built for the patient goaltender who owns the crease the way a bear owns a campsite.

items.name: Garage-sale helmet
items.desc: Someone wrote GARY inside it in marker. You are Gary now.

items.name: Honest Lid
items.desc: Certified. Adjustable. Beige, because beige was cheapest.

items.name: CMC Toque Pro
items.desc: Our thickest liner, like a toque your nan knit out of rules. Sorry it's a touch heavy.

items.name: CMC Featherweight
items.desc: So light you'll forget it's there. Please try to remember it's there.

items.name: CMC Full Cage
items.desc: Keeps all of your teeth in the general area of your mouth. The bars do get in the way of looking down at the puck, a little. Sorry.

items.name: CMC Half Visor
items.desc: Clear view, partial dignity. Comes with an anti-fog cloth and a gentle reminder.

items.name: Garage-sale gloves
items.desc: Stiff as two cardboard boxes and smelling like a decade of Tuesdays.

items.name: Honest Mitts
items.desc: They'll stiffen up after one season. We could lie, but we're Honest.

items.name: CMC Mitten Classic
items.desc: The glove that built the company, apart from the mittens, which built the company first.

items.name: CMC Knit-Back Pro
items.desc: Our lightest glove. We sewed less glove. Please be careful with your hands, they're lovely.

items.name: CMC Heritage Gauntlet
items.desc: Long cuff, double-stitched palm, built for people who block shots for fun. We worry about you.

items.name: Garage-sale shoulder pads
items.desc: Built in the shoulder-pad decade. You look like a refrigerator wearing a jersey.

items.name: Honest Shell
items.desc: Plastic caps, foam, straps. It's what's inside every shoulder pad, just without the pretending.

items.name: CMC Bulwark
items.desc: For defencemen and people who say 'go ahead' to large men. Sorry about the bulk.

items.name: CMC Lightline
items.desc: Minimal caps for skaters who'd rather not be hit at all. A lovely plan. Good luck with it.

items.name: Garage-sale elbow pads
items.desc: Velcro that has lost the will to velcro.

items.name: Honest Elbows
items.desc: Elbow pads. We don't have a joke. They're just good elbow pads.

items.name: CMC Hinge
items.desc: A floating cap that takes the fall for you. A little stiff at full reach. We're sorry, it's the price of love.

items.name: Garage-sale shin guards
items.desc: One says LEFT. Both are right.

items.name: Honest Shins
items.desc: Keeps the front of your leg on the inside of your leg.

items.name: CMC Shinfort
items.desc: A wraparound knee cap and calf guard. Heavier, we know. Your knees will send a thank-you card.

items.name: CMC Sprint Shin
items.desc: Trimmed for a quicker stride. We trimmed the safety a little too. Sorry, that's how trimming works.

items.name: Garage-sale pants
items.desc: Kodiak breezers from a team that folded in 1994. The logo is a bear holding a cassette tape.

items.name: Honest Breezers
items.desc: Hockey pants. Black, because every team wears black pants, and we like to be included.

items.name: CMC Tundra Pant
items.desc: Full kidney and tailbone coverage for anyone who falls the way most of us fall. A bit warm. Sorry.

items.name: CMC Racer Pant
items.desc: Tapered and quick. Basically speed skating shorts with good manners.

items.name: Lost-and-found goalie pads
items.desc: From the arena's lost and found, where they had been for some time. They absorb water, sound and hope.

items.name: Honest Goalie Pads
items.desc: Big, white, rectangular. Exactly what you drew when you were eight.

items.name: Kodiak Heritage Leathers (vintage)
items.desc: Brown leather and deer hair from the era when goalies were mostly bruise. Pucks bounce off them like a trampoline. Very authentic.

items.name: CMC Fortress
items.desc: Pucks die softly here. You'll move a bit like a wardrobe. We're sorry, and also not.

items.name: CMC Butterfly Lite
items.desc: Light and springy for goaltenders who'd rather get there first and apologise to their knees later.

items.name: CMC Big Mitt
items.desc: A deep pocket the size of a casserole dish. Heavy, but things go in and stay in, like a good casserole dish.

items.name: CMC Quick Trap
items.desc: Light, fast, and a little thin in the palm. You'll feel the slapshots. We're sorry in advance.

items.name: Honest Chest Protector
items.desc: Foam in the shape of a goalie. The goalie is extra.

items.name: CMC Chest Fortress
items.desc: Wear it and pucks become a mild inconvenience. Arms move a little slower. Sorry, physics.

items.name: Honest Goalie Mask
items.desc: Plain white. Paint it yourself. Every goalie does, so we stopped bothering.

items.name: CMC Mask Pro
items.desc: Fibreglass and kevlar with a cat-eye cage. Comes in Millbrook green if you ask Bev nicely.

items.name: Honest Cloth Tape (roll)
items.desc: Sticks to sticks. Also to hair, dogs and the inside of your bag.

items.name: Kodiak Pro Waxed Tape (roll)
items.desc: Pre-waxed in the traditional manner, which we invented in 2011.

items.name: Honest Skate Guards
items.desc: Stop walking on the parking lot in your skates. Bev is watching.

owner_lines.greet_first: You must be the new one. Sit. Give me those skates. No, I'm not asking.
greet: Door's open, heat's on, coffee's a dollar.
If you're here for the bathroom, it's for customers. Buy tape.
Back again. Those edges look like you skated to Harlow Falls on the highway.
owner_lines.starter_stick: Is that Ray's stick? Eighty-five flex and a banana. Ray had forearms like a bridge and the aim of a sprinkler. Let me fix it before you hurt someone.
owner_lines.sharpen_deep: Three-eighths. You'll turn on a dime and give change. You'll also be slower in a straight line than my sister, and she's got a hip.
owner_lines.sharpen_flat: A full inch. You'll glide like a Zambelli going downhill. Don't try to stop.
owner_lines.sharpen_standard: Half inch. The way God and the 1979 instruction manual intended.
owner_lines.curve_composite: I'll heat it. I don't promise it. Composites remember what they were. Like my ex-husband.
owner_lines.curve_banana: That's as far as the rules go, and as far as your accuracy goes, too.
owner_lines.lie_low: Flat lie. Blade's out in front like a rake. Good for poking. Bad for anything near your skates.
owner_lines.lie_high: Upright lie. Puck stays close, like a dog that knows you've got cheese.
owner_lines.cut: Every inch I cut makes it stiffer. Every inch you whine makes it cost more.
owner_lines.plug: A wooden plug in a carbon stick. It's not pretty. Neither was your last game.
owner_lines.broke_stick: Warlock? Again? Says right on it, 'warranty void near a slapshot'.
owner_lines.warlock: The Warlock rep wears sunglasses indoors. I don't trust him. The sticks are fine, they just die young.
owner_lines.grafton: Grafton wants an appointment. For skates. Laurent drove out from the city just to measure your feet, so be nice.
owner_lines.closed: CLOSED SUNDAYS. Bev is at church or the casino in Kessler. She won't say which.
owner_lines.broke: You've got eleven dollars. That's a sharpening and a lecture, and the lecture's free.
owner_lines.promotion: Senior AAA? In Kessler? Get your edges done the day before. That barn's ice is like a gravel road.
